title: Sea Sabella Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Welcome to Sea Sabella, a luxury three-story beachfront home that boasts fifty feet of Gulf frontage featuring some of the best Gulf and sunset views! Gorgeous prime beachfront home with over 35 shops and restaurants within walking distance of your door.
description_expanded: Description2314 East County Hwy 30AKING, KING, KINGBeachfront Luxury in the Heart of SeasideWelcome to Sea Sabella, an exceptional three-story beachfront home in Seaside, Florida, offering 50 feet of private Gulf frontage and some of the most breathtaking sunset views along 30A. Ideally positioned on East Ruskin Street, this premier Seaside vacation rental sits directly on the sand and just one block from Seaside Town Center and the Amphitheater, placing over 35 shops, restaurants, and events within effortless walking distance.Thoughtful Design & Coastal CraftsmanshipSea Sabella is a masterfully designed coastal retreat, showcasing curated designer furnishings and striking architectural details throughout. One of the home’s most distinctive features is its sunken cypress siding, custom-milled from reclaimed North Florida river wood, adding warmth, texture, and a true sense of place. Guests enjoy the convenience of two designated parking spaces in private driveways upon arrival.First-Floor Guest Suites & Beachfront Outdoor LivingThe first level features two king primary guest suites, each with a private ensuite bathroom, offering comfort and privacy for guests. A secondary living area opens directly onto an expansive covered beachfront deck, where the Gulf serves as your soundtrack. This outdoor space is fully equipped with lighted dining for eight, plush lounge seating, and a gas grill, making it ideal for relaxed meals and evenings spent enjoying the sea breeze just steps from the shoreline.Second-Floor Great Room with Panoramic Gulf ViewsA striking rift-sawn white oak staircase with glass railings leads to the second floor—the heart of the home. Here, an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen space unfolds with unobstructed Gulf views from nearly every angle.The chef’s kitchen is outfitted with top-tier appliances, including a Sub-Zero refrigerator, wine cooler, and ice maker; a Wolf range and oven; Bosch dishwasher; Kohler sink; Blanco faucet; and custom floor-to-ceiling cabinetry. At the center, a waterfall-edge white marble island invites gathering, entertaining, and casual dining.A German-engineered Roeder folding glass wall opens the interior to a spectacular split-level teak deck, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living. This expansive outdoor lounge features a wrap-around sectional and offers 180-degree Gulf views, making it the perfect setting for morning coffee, afternoon relaxation, or sunset cocktails.Private Third-Floor Primary Suite RetreatThe entire third floor is dedicated to the private king primary suite, accessed via open-riser stairs that allow natural light to flow throughout the space. This serene retreat includes a spa-inspired bathroom with a glass-enclosed rain shower, an Oceania jetted tub with light therapy, vein-cut silver travertine, and premium Kohler and Hansgrohe fixtures. A dedicated vanity area enhances comfort and convenience.Please note: the primary suite is enclosed with a privacy curtain rather than a traditional door, maintaining the home’s open, architectural aesthetic. Step outside onto your private open-air Gulf-front deck, furnished with chaise loungers, and enjoy an unmatched front-row view of the emerald waters below.An Unforgettable Seaside Beachfront ExperienceSea Sabella delivers the ultimate Seaside vacation experience—luxury beachfront living with the charm of town just steps away. Whether you’re soaking in sunsets from your private deck, walking to dinner and live music, or waking to the sound of waves, this extraordinary home offers a rare opportunity to experience Seaside at its very best.*5-night stay for Spring, Spring Break, & Summer; 3 night for Fall and winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURESFeatures 2,952 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spacePrivate Seaside residential beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion1-minute walk, 148 feet to beach accessThree king bedrooms, each with a private ensuite bathroomDesigner kitchen complete with wine refrigerator and ice makerDeep soaker tub for spa-like relaxationAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedGolf cart policy: Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR24-000892
